More importantly, the claim asserts the total complexity is $O(P)$, which is generally incorrect for a reduction/compositing phase involving $P$ processors (which is typically $O(P)$ work but $O(log P)$ time, or $O(N)$ work for $N$ pixels). The source notes that on networked workstations, communication takes 97% of compositing time, but does not provide the specific asymptotic formula $O(P)$ with $C$ defined as logarithmic.
